ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms the failure boundary, causal evidence and the symptom-only-fix flag are declared; it does not show the cause is correct.
offer: Locate the first boundary where expected behavior diverges and record the causal observation. Fix the shared cause and retain a reproduction rather than masking the final symptom.

minimal.reason: Name the first boundary where behavior diverged from expectation. Without it the fix targets the final symptom, so record the component and input where it first went wrong.

mid.reason: Record the observation that links cause to failure, such as a log line or failing input. Claims without evidence cannot be re-checked, so attach the trace.

maximal.reason: Set symptom-only fix to false. Masking the final symptom leaves the shared cause in place, so fix the cause and keep a reproduction.
